correctness.rationale: The exact exponential fixed-point equations give f>d, H=de/(f-d), and the stated P positivity criterion; for strong Allee q(0)>0, q(eta)<0 and q(+infinity)>0 imply two positive prey-only roots around eta. On the explicit alpha interval (4,6) substitution gives exactly four nonnegative fixed points. At the origin both multipliers are in (0,1). At coexistence the exact Jacobian is [[1/3,-2/3],[(6-alpha)/6,1]], trace 4/3 and determinant 1-alpha/9, with three strictly positive Jury margins alpha/9,(6-alpha)/9,(30-alpha)/9. Both are hyperbolic sinks. The prey-only triangular multipliers yield lower saddle, upper source for alpha<alpha_F, upper -1 multiplier at alpha_F, and upper saddle above it. The full proof is algebraic; package exact symbolic checks and independent direct substitution were performed.

value.rationale: The source explicitly isolates weak Allee dynamics despite defining a complementary biologically meaningful strong effect. The accepted result gives a complete exact four-fixed-point local type diagram on a nontrivial open parameter interval; it proves two robust and ecologically distinct attractors (extinction and prey–predator coexistence) and locates a sharp change in the upper prey-only boundary state, including predator invasibility. This is a concrete meaningful dynamical bistability window, not a generic assertion that strong Allee effects may cause hysteresis or an isolated numerical demonstration.
